name: interleaved_loops
description: Identical calls that are NOT consecutive. The same read_file(path=a.py) appears four times, always separated by a model_call, followed by one genuinely adjacent repeat. loop_max_run must report 2: the published definition says a non-tool-call record breaks a run, so the longest unbroken run is the final adjacent pair, not the four separated calls. An implementation that filters the model_calls out before comparing would weld all five into a run of 5 and report a loop the harness never executed. redundant_call_count still reports 4, because repeating a (tool, args_digest) pair does not require adjacency.
